issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Stock.add(String) as returning void, but both the template and the solution implement Stock.add(String) returning int. This mismatch between the specification (problem_statement.md) and the provided code can confuse students about the expected method signature and return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the problem statement UML with the code by changing the UML signature to +add(String): int and/or update the description to document that add returns the new quantity (or -1 if not found). Alternatively, change the template/solution to implement add(String) as void if the UML signature is intended; however, updating the UML to match the existing template is recommended to avoid breaking the provided code.
